Neumann Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 256.36% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Neumann Capital Management Llc bought 20,509 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 28,509 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.83 million, up from 8,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Neumann Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $835.64 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.46% or $2.37 during the last trading session, reaching $164.69. About 27.49M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
